chunks: What We have revealed to you of the Book is the truth, and proves (what has been sent) before it to be true. Verily God is informed of His creatures and sees everything.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being described as the truth that validates previous scriptures?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's role as the ultimate criterion (Furqan) that authenticates the core truths of previous revelations while preserving them from distortion. It highlights the divine attribute of 'Khabir' (All-Aware) and 'Basir' (All-Seeing), emphasizing that God’s knowledge encompasses both the textual integrity of the scripture and the spiritual state of the believers. This affirmation serves as a foundation for the concept of Tahrif (alteration) in earlier texts, asserting the Quran's supremacy as the final, uncorrupted word of God.
